# What A2 listed that is not a part: the $0 audit of round 78 (2026-11-16)

Every listed item, both arms, settled as `probe_score` settles H (counting unresolved points for the answer):

| Arm | Listed items | Settled part | Already decided by a choice | Only the route to the answer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| control | 71 | 70 | 1 | 0 |
| A2 | 137 | 128 | 5 | 4 |

So A2 lists nearly twice the parts (128 against 70), and 9 of its 137 entries (7%) are not parts.

| Kind | A2's entries | Where they come from |
|---|---|---|
| an outcome the choices decide | Hugging Face: "a delay past March 24, 2028", "termination … as a separate outcome", "whether the acquisition is delayed past the check date", "whether the deal is terminated" | the outcome's "versus being repriced, delayed past the check date or terminated"; Still open and Ruled out decide delay and termination |
| a comparison the ranges carry | data-centre capacity: "the comparison with Huang's … 10, 20 gigawatts a year" (the control lists it once too) | the reference carried in the middle range. The family split recorded in RESULT.md applies here; it is settled once in this run |
| only the route to the answer | CPO: "Nvidia networking revenue", "supplier CPO/NPO laser shipments" (the outcome's "as reflected in …"); capex: "the October 2026 guidance" (the period's "checked at …") | words that name the material the answer will be read from |

**What must still be listed (from the same run):**
- a cap on an approval (part, every reader);
- repricing joined with delay and termination in one entry (item 126): the third readers mark it `part` for the repricing, which
  no choice decides;
- the shortage persisting beside the price (D436's own example).

**A question about a disclosure itself:** in the store, "Will NVIDIA disclose in its quarterly results or 10-K that Vera Rubin made
volume shipments" asks the disclosure as part of the event. A rule that drops "where the answer is read from" must not drop that.

**A candidate (A3 = A2 plus one sentence in the closing check, where AGENTS §6 puts a test the step applies to each entry):**

> *Then read each not_judged entry back. Drop an entry that an answer choice already decides (for an event, a delay past the due day
> is Still open, a formal withdrawal or rejection is Ruled out) and an entry that only names the source the answer will be read from;
> when an entry joins such an outcome with a part no choice decides, such as a change of price, keep that part.*

| Part of the sentence | Source |
|---|---|
| a decided outcome is not "not judged" | D397: the rest is "shown beside the answer as not judged"; an outcome a rung decides is judged |
| Still open and Ruled out | D420 and the request's own event rule |
| "only names the source" (narrow: a disclosure that is itself asked is not "only" a source) | h-brief's `settlement`, which both reader families applied identically in this run |
| keep the undecided part of a mixed entry | the third readers' ruling on item 126; D436 (a second side stays as context) |

It is about 420 characters. The examples come from no covered company.

## D409 · 2026-11-10 · An event is answered in three outcomes: it happened, it is ruled out, or neither by the due day

- **Asked:** "事件类的题（比如“监管会不会批准”“调查会不会罚款”），答案要分几种结局？现在让模型自己写五种状态，这是最容易出漏洞的地方：两家读者都认定的 7 个漏洞里，6 个出在第四、第五种状态的细分上。"
  - Options: three outcomes (recommended): "发生了 / 明确落空（被否决、被放弃）/ 到期还没结果。第三种由程序写成“前两种都不是”，所以不会有遗漏。保住了“否决”和“还在等”的区别；更细的区别（如“附条件批准”）列为“不判”。这是我的建议，写法还要先免费验证。"; yes or no only (the simplest; "rejected" and "still waiting" become one No, which the council held loses a difference an analyst cares about); several outcomes where they are needed, the number not fixed (the council's recommendation; a new structure, one more round of design).
  - Alex: "分三种 (Recommended)".
- **Decided:** on the clean ladder step an event's answer has at most three outcomes: the event has happened by the due day; the
  event is ruled out (decided against, abandoned); neither. The third is written by code as "neither of the two holds", so no
  outcome is without a rung. A finer difference (an approval with conditions against one without) is listed as not judged
  (D397). The wording of the request, the schema and the checks are designed, checked at no cost and reviewed before any send
  (D408).
- **Supersedes:** D399 (the request teaches how to build an event's five states) and, with it, the five states of an event in
  the clean ladder step; D404's rule on naming a theme's five states has nothing left to apply to.
- **Evidence put to him:** five states for the company are faulted by both reader families in 10 of 17 ladders, yes/no in 2 of
  24; of the seven gaps both found, six sit in the division beyond three outcomes and one in a Yes that needs a confirmation
  its No does not. The council's dissent (several outcomes where needed) was put to him as the third option.
- **Scope:** the clean path's ladder step.

## D410 · 2026-11-10 · A group named in a judged question and not listed member by member is not a fault of the question

- **Asked:** "题目里写“四大云厂商”（the big four hyperscalers）但没有列出是哪四家，算不算“问题没说清楚”？严的读者判不合格，松的读者和我认为这是通用叫法。按裁决“问错题”的 11 份里有 8 份是这一类，所以需要你定一个读法，下次两家读者才能按同一把尺子评。"
  - Options: not a fault (recommended): "行业里通用的叫法可以直接用，不要求列出成员。按这个读法，这 8 份不再算“问错题”。"; a fault, the members must be listed.
  - Alex: "不算问题 (Recommended)".
- **Decided:** in reading a judged question (mark Q of the Stage A form), a group named as the trade names it ("the big four AI
  hyperscalers", "the top five hyperscalers") is a name the question gives; a question is not failed for not listing the
## D416 · 2026-11-10 · The lines stay; the ruling out of an event as a typed answer is proved small before anything else

- **Asked:** "第三次正式测试里，两类读者都判错的最大一类是：把“到期还没发生”写成“明确落空”（例如“2026年12月31日已过，Vera Rubin 还没出货”被当成明确落空）。140 份已存事件题答案里共 7 份。我的建议是把“明确落空”从一句自由写的话改成两格必填：“谁作出决定”和“决定是什么”。在已存答案上对照，7 份错的里 6 份没地方填，但第 7 份（“当局决定继续调查”）挡不住；模型会不会老实填，只有真发才知道。这一步怎么走？"
  - Options: prove the change small first (recommended): "线保持不变。在 6 道“产品能否按期出货”的题上，新旧两种格式同时各发三遍（约 4 美分），不通过的条件事先写死，我自己逐份读。这只是候选改法，不是已证明的修法；通过了再谈第四次正式测试。"; stop here and change nothing.
  - Alex: "先小额验证这个改法 (Recommended)".
- **Decided:** Alex's six lines stay as they are. The ruling out of an event is tried as a typed answer (who decides; what they
  decide) in place of one free sentence: the six product-deadline theses, the present shape and the typed one sent in the same
  minutes, three sends each, what does not pass written before the send, every answer read by Claude. It is a candidate, said
  so to him: it has no place for six of the seven stored faults, does not exclude the seventh, and only a send shows whether
  the model fills it rightly.
- **Evidence behind the question:** `clean-arch/step4-2026-11-10/stage_a/result-3/RESULT.md`, `wait-as-ruling-out-hand-read.md`, `wait-accounts.json`.
- **Scope:** the clean path's ladder step. It amends the shape D409 gave an event's answer, if it passes.

## D417 · 2026-11-10 · A figure for a rolling twelve months with no publication day in the texts is declined

- **Asked:** "有两道题问的是“某项调查统计的未来 12 个月里，中国企业把多少 AI 芯片预算给国产”。这不是整年数字，文章也没说后续调查哪天公布。到期日改由程序定之后，系统对这两道题基本不出题了（6 次里 5 次），理由是“没有能核对的公布日期”。这是新出现的行为，你还没确认过；两位裁决读者对它也意见相反，第 4 条线过不过就取决于它。怎么定？"
  - Options: confirm, no judged question (recommended): "滚动 12 个月、又没有公布日期的数字，不写成判断题，如实说明理由。代价：这两道题不再有可判的问题。"; write the question with the period's last day as its due day (the follow-up survey may not exist that day; a further rule to build and prove).
  - Alex: "确认：这类题不出题 (Recommended)".
- **Decided:** a figure that covers a period which is not one fiscal or calendar year (a survey's rolling twelve months) and
  for which neither the topic nor the item gives a publication day is declined, with that reason. The cost he was shown: such
  topics get no judged question. This confirms the behaviour D414's refusal produced and that was reported as not confirmed.
- **Scope:** the clean path's ladder step; mark N of the readers' form.

## D418 · 2026-11-10 · A government's permission or ban on a class of product belongs to the theme, not to the company

- **Asked:** "“中国政府是否放行英伟达 H200 芯片在华销售”这类题，系统大多归在“英伟达”名下，有时归在行业主题“芯片出口管制”名下，同一道题三次归属还会不一致。第三次测试里归在公司名下的 5 份，两类读者都判为归错了，认为应归行业主题。区别是：归行业主题的题会给每家相关公司的判断都看到，归公司的只给这一家看。归哪边？"
  - Options: the theme "chip-export-controls" (recommended): "两类读者意见一致。我需要在提示词里加一条归属规则（政府对某类产品的放行或禁令归行业主题），并先小额验证不带坏别的题，比如法国对英伟达本身的反垄断调查仍归公司。"; the company (the readers' form would then be changed to that reading).
  - Alex: "归行业主题“芯片出口管制” (Recommended)".
## D420 · 2026-11-10 · A proceeding that formally ends without the conclusion the question asks for is ruled out; the question stays

- **Asked:** "题目问的是“法国竞争管理局会不会在 2027 年 1 月 31 日前公布对英伟达反垄断调查的结论”。到期前可能有三种情况：① 公布结案决定（哪怕不处罚），算“发生了”；③ 调查还在继续，算“还在等”。这两点没有争议。有争议的是 ②：当局正式宣布放弃或撤回调查，但没有公布题目问的那种结论。模型每次写法不一样，读者也各执一词。② 算什么？"
  - Options: it is ruled out (recommended): "题目保持原样，问的仍是“有没有公布结论”。这类题固定有三种结果：公布了／当局正式放弃且没有结论／还在查。这也是目前多数已存答案的写法，且符合现有规则“判题目点名追踪的那件事”。不写“明确落空”的答案将算错。"; ask instead whether the investigation is over (two outcomes; it tracks another event than the conclusion the thesis names).
  - Alex: "② 算“明确落空” (Recommended)".
- **Decided:** for a proceeding an authority conducts and whose asked-for event is its published decision or conclusion: a
  published closing decision, with or without a penalty, is the event happened; the authority formally abandoning or
  withdrawing the proceeding without that decision or conclusion is the event ruled out; the proceeding still going on the due
  day is the wait. Such an event always has a ruling out, and an answer that names none, or that writes the authority's
  decision to go on as the ruling out, is at fault. The judged question stays the one the thesis's outcome names.
- **Scope:** the clean path's ladder step; mark R of the readers' form.

## D421 · 2026-11-10 · Each further change is tested alone; all passing, the fourth Stage A is sent without asking again

- **Asked:** "接下来怎么走？我建议每项改动单独测，不再捆在一起：(a) 把你上一题的定义写进提示词，在三道法国调查题上单独测；(b) 把归属规则收窄成“题目追踪的是政府决定本身才归行业主题，追踪公司自己销售的仍归公司”，单独测；(c) 在 (a) 之后把“分两格填”再单独测一次，停止条件不变。调查题不出题那条直接并入。三项合计约 10 美分；第四次正式测试约 11 美分；目前累计 0.90 美元，上限 3 美元。"
  - Options: test the three apart and send the fourth Stage A when all pass (recommended): "(a)(b)(c) 各自小额验证并过评审。全部通过就直接发第四次正式测试；任何一项没通过就停下来找你。"; drop the typed shape and do (a) and (b) only; test the three and ask before the fourth Stage A; stop here.
  - Alex: "三项分别测，全过就直接发第四次 (Recommended)".
- **Decided:** D417 goes into the working request. Then, each beside the working request and on its own: (a) D420's rule in the
  request, on the three French theses; (b) D418's sentence narrowed (the theme when the tracked outcome is the government's
  decision; the company when it is the company's own sales under it); (c) after (a), the typed ruling out once more, the same
  stop condition as before. Each is reviewed in the council. When all three pass, the fourth Stage A (the same 44 theses,
  three sends each, within D401's $3) is sent without asking again; one that does not pass stops the line and goes to him.
  Stage B still needs his word. This replaces D419's terms for these changes.
- **Scope:** the clean path's ladder step.
docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/arm-a2/candidate-system.txt:5:- A topic's description and outcome together may ask about more than one thing. Judge the one the topic's outcome names as what is tracked. List every other part of the topic's description and outcome that the question leaves out, a second figure or event, a condition or a comparison, in not_judged, each with one sentence on why it is not the one tracked. A second side of the same bet, for example a market's tightness beside the volume shipped, a share beside the total it is part of, or capacity beside the demand it serves, stays in the one question as context: list it in not_judged. A second side is not by itself a reason to decline; decline only when no part is the main one, or when the main part itself meets a case below. Never fold two things into one ladder: "Will the regulator approve the drug for a second use, and how many patients will take it in the first year?" is judged on the approval when that is what its outcome names, and the patient count is listed; "How much will the carrier's fuel bill be next year, and will its pilots strike?" is judged on the fuel bill when that is what its outcome names, and the strike is listed.
docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/arm-a2/candidate-system.txt:13:- An event is answered in event, in at most three outcomes. happened is the condition under which the event the question asks about has happened by the due day. ruled_out says who can rule the event as a whole out before the due day, and how: by_whom names the company, authority, court or party whose decision it would be; decision is one full sentence that names them and says what they decide against the event as a whole, or that they formally abandon or withdraw it, after the item's day. The due day arriving without the event is no one's decision and is never written there: it is what is left. ruled_out is null only when no one's decision can rule the event out before the due day. Write no other condition: what is left, neither of the two, needs none, and where both would hold the event counts as happened. A difference inside an outcome, such as an approval with conditions against one without, is not an outcome of its own; when the topic's description or outcome names it, list it in not_judged. A regulator reviewing a merger gives: happened, the regulator has cleared the merger by the due day; ruled_out, by_whom the regulator or the parties to the merger, decision the regulator blocks the merger or the parties withdraw the filing. An authority's investigation or examination that the question asks to end in a published decision or conclusion always has a ruling out: happened, the authority publishes that decision or conclusion by the due day, whatever it finds; ruled_out, by_whom the authority, decision the authority formally abandons or withdraws the proceeding without it. The proceeding still going on the due day is neither, and a decision to go on with it is not a ruling out. A safety agency examining a carmaker's defect gives: happened, the agency publishes its findings; ruled_out, by_whom the agency, decision the agency formally closes or withdraws the examination without publishing any.
docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/arm-a2/candidate-closing.txt:1:Before you return the answer, check it once. Read the question back: does it ask one thing, the one the topic's outcome names, and is every other part of the topic's description and outcome listed in not_judged? For a figure, check that each range starts exactly where the one below it ends. For an event, check that happened is the event the question asks about; that ruled_out names who decides and a decision of theirs against that event as a whole or its abandonment, never the due day arriving or the event merely being still awaited, and is null only when no one's decision can rule the event out; and that each can be checked on the due day. Check that a reference's kind says truly whether its words state an expectation or the amount already reported for the same quantity, that its value is the number its words state, and, for a figure, that the value falls in the middle range, or that the middle range runs from at or below a stated range's lower end to at or above its upper end, that every bound is a figure and not a future target, and that the due day follows the rules above. For an amount the company owes, guarantees or has committed to pay, check that favourable_end is lower unless the topic or the item settles the other end or the topic's own words say that more of it is good. Correct the answer where a check fails.

**No-go on A3 as written.** The audit identifies a useful distinction, but the proposed example would teach the wrong answer for some events.

- **A delay past the due day is not always “Still open.”** A formal decision to defer an event beyond that day can put it in “Ruled out”; completion can also take precedence if it happened. The existing request defines “Still open” as neither of the first two choices, and D409 gives the same three-way structure. The check should ask whether the *actual choices* decide the listed part, rather than assign every delay to one choice. [A2 request](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/arm-a2/candidate-system.txt:13>), [D409](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/DECISIONS-log.md:4502>)

- **The “only a source” qualification is necessary**, and the disclosure-that-is-itself-asked example belongs in the controls. The H brief is a reading instruction, not an independent product decision; D397 supports distinguishing judged from unjudged parts, but does not itself define every source-only case. [Audit](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/OVERLIST-AUDIT.md>), [D397](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/DECISIONS-log.md:4326>)

- **Keep the undecided portion of mixed entries.** The item-126 ruling supports that distinction on this example; it does not establish a general rewriting procedure. Also, “change of price” comes from a test case, so it should not become a prompt example under the rule against examples taken from test articles. [Working rules §6](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/AGENTS.md>)

- **Three sends and the existing +1 rule may be proposed for a new diagnostic, but are not yet shown to be a sound test.** The rule can reject on ordinary control variation, as A2 illustrates. Reading every failure remains necessary but cannot retrospectively turn a negative into a pass. Before sending, show how the control performs against itself or otherwise justify what the bar can distinguish; retain both countings and the full per-send results. [A2 rule](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/DESIGN-A2.md:47>), [working rules §7.3](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/AGENTS.md:326>)

Revise the design at $0 around the actual-choice test, mixed entries and source-only distinction. Include the full-request audit, the required account of the model’s listing choices, and the prompt-length tradeoff before returning for review. A2 remains negative.

CONSENSUS: no, because the proposed event example is inaccurate and the new test’s control-variation problem remains unresolved.
